title: MACHINES DIE IN A BLAST
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 13). A machine you killed only left a silhouette that turned and faded. Now it goes up in the explosion from the last build, sized to what died: a Crawler pops small, a Sentry or a Howler bursts like a charge, a Warden goes up big with two smaller pops after it. Pillagers and the Stray are people and do not explode. A blast only shows where you can see the body die, so a fireball never gives away a kill behind a wall. Drawing only: nothing about the kill, the loot or the raid dice changes, and bot raids skip it.
now: Machines die in a blast sized to the machine: Crawlers pop, Wardens go up big.
